div.div:
Auth mechanism
Access JWT (15 min) in memory, sent as Bearer
Refresh token: rotating httpOnly cookie gd_refresh,
path /api/auth, SameSite=Lax, stored hashed
30-day refresh, 90-day absolute session,
token_version revocation; X-Device-Id header

div.div:
API
[Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2 async]
modules: identity, deeds
/api/health
/api/auth/: config, signup, login,
oauth/{provider}, refresh, logout
/api/users/me (+ age-consent, phone/start,
phone/verify, qr, qr/rotate)
/api/users/{handle} (+ /deed-counts)
M2 deeds:
/api/scans, /api/deeds (+ options, {id},
PATCH, withdraw)
/api/invites/by-token/{token} (+ accept),
/api/invites/{id}/reissue
/api/me/deeds, /api/me/invites, /api/me/self-logs
Postgres rate limits, limits from config rows,
outbox emit, audit log

invites, verification_events,
deed_revisions, self_logs

div.div:
Worker [Procrastinate]
core.dispatch_outbox (every 5 s)
core.handle_event (8 retries)
identity.purge_expired_records (03:17)
deeds.expire_invites (every 15 min)
deeds.purge_unconsumed_scans (03:37)
